### Financial & Risk Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **General Ledger** | 6 years | Accounting standards |
| **Transaction Ledger** | 6 years | Regulatory, audit |
| **Risk Assessments** | 5 years | Risk framework |
| **Incident Reports** | 5 years | Loss data, patterns |
| **Fraud Investigations** | 5 years | Fraud prevention |
| **Third-Party Vendor Contracts** | 6 years post-termination | Contractual, compliance |

raw_entities.description: Policy governing the retention periods for financial, risk, and compliance-related documents. Establishes mandatory retention schedules for general ledger, transaction ledger, risk assessments, incident reports, fraud investigations, and third-party vendor contracts based on accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.

properties.name: Financial and Risk Document Retention Policy

properties.core_policy_statement: The bank maintains defined retention periods for financial and risk-related documents to meet accounting standards, regulatory requirements, audit obligations, and fraud prevention needs.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to general ledger records, transaction ledgers, risk assessments, incident reports, fraud investigations, and third-party vendor contracts.

properties.name: Third-Party Vendor Contract Record Retention Requirement

properties.key_obligation: Maintain general ledger records for a minimum of 6 years
properties.how_cited: Basis for general ledger retention period

properties.key_obligation: Maintain transaction ledger records for a minimum of 6 years to support regulatory and audit activities
properties.how_cited: Basis for transaction ledger retention period

properties.risk_definition: Risk of loss or failure arising from inadequate or failed internal processes, systems, or external events affecting financial and operational records.
properties.required_response: Maintain risk assessment records for 5 years to support risk framework and loss pattern analysis

properties.risk_definition: Risk of fraudulent activity or financial crime affecting the bank or its customers.
properties.required_response: Maintain fraud investigation records for 5 years and incident reports for 5 years to support fraud prevention and loss data analysis

properties.risk_definition: Risk of non-compliance with regulatory, contractual, or audit obligations.
properties.required_response: Maintain third-party vendor contracts for 6 years post-termination and transaction ledgers for 6 years to demonstrate compliance
